title: Irugapatru
desc: A marriage counsellor and her partner, along with two other couples, navigate the trials and tribulations of a love relationship.

title: Sakka Podu Podu Raja
desc: Santa turns Bhavani, a gangster, into his enemy after helping his friend elope with the thug's sister. Later, Santa falls in love with a girl, who turns out to be Bhavani's younger sister.

title: Pathu Endrathukulla
desc: A driving instructor is tasked to deliver Shakeela, a young woman, to a landlord in Mussoorie. But soon, he finds out that her life is in danger and decides to be her saviour.

title: Whistle Podu
desc: A man tries to fulfil his father's dream of opening a sports academy. However, complications arise when he becomes embroiled in a revenge scheme involving the mafia.

title: Chandi Veeran
desc: Upon returning to his village, Paari strives to resolve the long-standing water conflict that claimed his father's life years ago.

title: Maamannan
desc: A father and his son must reconcile their differences and face their past in order to defeat a late politician's privileged son, who is out to humiliate them.

title: Sivanudukkai
desc: A boy becomes an atheist after his parents' death. Unbeknown to him, he is born for a divine purpose and must stop a demon from sacrificing his lover.

title: Pisasu
desc: Upon witnessing the death of a young girl in an accident, Siddharth, a violinist, begins to feel a supernatural presence in his house. The mystery begins to unfold when he meets the girl's father.

title: Pizza II: Villa
desc: A writer moves into a villa in Puducherry, a gift from his deceased father. He is in for a shock when he learns that his father's old paintings actually depict events from his own life.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Yaar Enda Mani-Evade Subrahm
desc: Driven by unrelenting ambition, Nani sets out on a transformative quest to the Himalayas, compelled by the tragic loss of his childhood friend and a series of daunting challenges.

title: Run Baby Run
desc: A man reluctantly agrees to help a medical student who is in trouble by sheltering her in his apartment. However, trouble ensues when she is found dead the next morning.

title: Romeo
desc: Arivu desires a real love connection but ends up with Leela, who marries him out of family obligation. However, despite their differences, he tries his best to win her over.

title: Anbarivu
desc: Twins, Anbu and Arivu, are separated at birth. Later, when their paths cross, the siblings are forced to switch families, as they strive to reunite their loved ones.

title: Inttelligent
desc: A successful software engineer becomes a vigilante following the demise of his mentor in a bid to seek revenge against those responsible for the latter's death.

title: Bheemla Nayak
desc: A battle begins between SI Bheemla Nayak, a righteous policeman, and Daniel Shekhar, an ex-havildar, when Daniel tricks Bheemla into surrendering to corruption.

title: Velainu Vandhutta Vellaikaaran
desc: A minister on his deathbed reveals to an MLA the whereabouts of billions in cash that he has stashed away. However, the minister's relatives are vexed when the MLA loses his memory in an accident.
